integrity: Analytic proof includes exact monodromy matrices and Schur–Cohn factorizations; symbolic/finite numerical checks reproduce algebra but are not independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Prescribed alternating positive steps on a two-dimensional linear matched-skew maximally monotone inclusion in exact arithmetic; not a universal nonlinear or adaptive FRB guarantee. Priority against unindexed older two-period Floquet analyses remains uncertain.
title: Exact two-period stability frontiers for two reflected-splitting step conventions
